title: ITR-5 Offline Utility for AY 2026-27 Now Available!
content:
# ITR-5 Offline Utility for AY 2026-27 Now Available!

Ek important update hai. Income Tax Department ne Assessment Year (AY) 2026-27 ke liye ITR-5 ki offline utility ko ab available kar diya hai. Taxpayers ab is utility ka use karke apne Income Tax Returns prepare kar sakte hain.

*   **Kya Available Hai?** Income Tax Return Form (ITR-5) ke liye offline utility release kar di gayi hai.
*   **Kis Assessment Year Ke Liye?** Yeh utility Assessment Year 2026-27 ke liye hai, yaani Financial Year 2025-26 ki income ke liye.
*   **Kab Release Hui?** Is utility ki availability 7 August, 2026 ko announce ki gayi thi.
*   **Kiske Liye Hai ITR-5?** ITR-5 un non-individual taxpayers ke liye hai jo companies, individuals, HUFs ya ITR-7 file karne wale entities nahi hain. Ismein partnership firms, LLPs (Limited Liability Partnerships), AOPs (Associations of Persons), BOIs (Bodies of Individuals), cooperative societies, aur local authorities jaise entities shamil hain.
*   **Fayda Kya Hai?** Offline utility se taxpayers bina continuous internet connection ke apna return prepare kar sakte hain, details validate kar sakte hain, aur JSON file generate karke e-Filing portal par upload kar sakte hain.
